name: Question_Bank
description: Configurable bank of clarification and triage questions used during the intake and assessment phases. Questions are discipline-specific, multilingual (English, Welsh, Polish), and ordered by priority. The LLM selects appropriate questions based on trigger conditions.
record_count_estimate: Low volume - tens to low hundreds of question records across all disciplines

fields.name: question_id
fields.description: Unique auto-incrementing identifier for each question

fields.name: discipline
fields.description: Trade discipline this question applies to, matching the work item discipline classification

fields.name: trigger_condition
fields.description: Condition expression that determines when this question should be asked (e.g. 'urgency=EMERGENCY', 'llm_confidence<0.70')

fields.name: follow_up_options
fields.description: JSON array of follow-up response options presented to the user as interactive buttons or list items

fields.name: expected_data_field
fields.description: Name of the work item field that the answer to this question populates (e.g. 'location_area', 'urgency')

fields.name: is_active
fields.description: Whether this question is currently active and available for use in conversation flows

fields.name: priority_order
fields.description: Priority order for question sequencing within a discipline. Lower numbers are asked first

fields.name: created_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the question was created

fields.name: updated_at
fields.description: Timestamp when the question was last modified

views.name: All Questions
views.description: Complete list of all questions in the bank

views.name: By Discipline
views.description: Questions grouped by trade discipline for configuration and review

views.name: Active Questions
views.description: Only currently active questions available for use in conversation flows
